Four statements about particles in an atom are listed.
1
Protons and neutrons have the same relative mass and different relative charges.
2
Protons and neutrons have different relative masses and the same relative charge.
3
Protons and electrons have the same relative mass and different relative charges.
4
Protons and electrons have different relative masses and different relative charges.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
